hyundai-grand-i10-nios.author: RL GNZLZ
hyundai-grand-i10-nios.alt: Hyundai Grand i10 (2023 facelift) in Fiery Red, front three-quarter view
hyundai-grand-i10-nios.note: Chilean-market Grand i10, which is the India-built Grand i10 NIOS exported as the 'Grand i10': facelift honeycomb grille, triangular DRL housings in the bumper corners and two-tone alloys as on the Indian NIOS facelift. Export base trim, so the DRL housings are unlit.

hyundai-venue.author: Gpkp
hyundai-venue.alt: Hyundai VENUE (second generation, 2025) in Titanium Black, front three-quarter view
hyundai-venue.note: Second-generation Indian VENUE shown on Hyundai's own stand at the Bangalore auto show in November 2025: horizon LED bar, quad-beam headlamps in tall housings, silver skid plate, VENUE placard.

hyundai-venue.author: Gpkp
hyundai-venue.alt: Hyundai VENUE (second generation, 2025) dashboard with curved twin screens and right-hand drive
hyundai-venue.note: Same Hyundai stand, Bangalore 2025 (Venue, Venue N Line and Creta on display). Right-hand drive, curved panoramic twin screens and the new four-dot steering wheel of the second-generation VENUE; not the N Line (no N wheel or red accents) and not the Creta (different wheel).

hyundai-creta-n-line.note: Indian-market CRETA N Line on Karnataka (KA) plates: N Line grille badge, red side-sill and bumper inserts, N-logo R18 alloys with red calipers.

hyundai-alcazar.note: Saudi-market 'Creta Grand', the India-built export version of the 2024 ALCAZAR facelift: same quad-beam H-shaped headlamps, dark grille, silver skid plate and R18 dual-tone alloys. Only the front is used because the export car's tailgate lettering differs.
